note: Triennial rural district council election, Newry No. 1 (County Down), fourteen divisions. Polling took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 in the three contested divisions (Carrickcrossan, Rathfriland North, Rathfriland South); four divisions had a single nomination and in seven no nomination was made, the sitting member continuing (Newry Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 5). * marks an old member as printed. Returned unopposed.
